content: Apply a combination of phenylephrine, mineral oil, and petrolatum externally to the cleansed hemorrhoidal area or the lower portion of the anal canal. This treatment can be applied up to four times daily, particularly at night, in the morning, or after bowel movements that may aggravate hemorrhoids. For application in the lower anal canal, remove the cover from the dispensing cap and attach the dispensing cap to the tube. For intrarectal use, remove the cover from the applicator, attach the applicator to the ointment tube, lubricate the applicator thoroughly, and gently insert it into the rectum. After each use, clean the applicator and replace the cover. For children under 12 years of age, the use of this product should be determined based on whether the benefits outweigh the risks. For individuals aged 12 years or older, follow the same application instructions as described above. This product is for external use only. It contains phenylephrine, which is an alpha-adrenergic agonist that induces localized vasoconstriction and reduces inflammation. Mineral oil acts as an emollient, softening stool in the colon by slowing the colonic absorption of fecal water. Petrolatum provides moisturizing and lubricating effects. Consult a healthcare professional before use, especially if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland. Discontinue use and contact a physician if hemorrhoids worsen or do not improve within seven days, or if symptoms such as bleeding, redness, irritation, swelling, pain, or other adverse effects develop or increase. If you are currently taking prescription medication for high blood pressure or depression, consult a healthcare professional before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose unless directed by a doctor. Avoid inserting the product into the rectum using fingers, mechanical devices, or applicators not provided with the product. Keep this product out of the reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical assistance or contact a poison control center immediately. This product is generally considered safe for use during pregnancy, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Copyright © 2010 First DataBank, Inc.
